verdict.rationale: Increase's docs explicitly support issuing unique Account Numbers at scale per counterparty/investor for reconciliation (docs-7, docs-10, docs-32, docs-35), a one-to-many Account/Account Number model enabling sub-account-like structures under a master Account (docs-17, docs-18), and FBO account support for master/sub structures (docs-30). Customer case studies (Ramp spinning up unique accounts per user, docs-46) corroborate real-world usage at scale. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of routing-number issuance mechanics and explicit documentation of a formal 'sub-account' hierarchy beyond the one-to-many account-number mapping.
